subthemes.name: Understanding why models generalize
subthemes.gist: Papers investigating the theoretical foundations that explain when and why machine learning models can successfully learn patterns from limited examples and perform well on new data.

subthemes.name: Proving how neural networks learn
subthemes.gist: Theoretical analysis of deep learning through mechanisms like implicit bias, gradient descent convergence, and the internal structure of learned representations.

subthemes.name: Handling uncertainty and imperfect information
subthemes.gist: Methods for models to quantify what they don't know, make robust predictions despite noisy data, and account for missing information in decision-making.

subthemes.name: Learning from causal relationships in data
subthemes.gist: Papers using causal reasoning to identify true cause-and-effect relationships in data, avoiding spurious correlations and enabling more reliable decision-making.

subthemes.name: Decision-making in changing or interactive environments
subthemes.gist: Theory for learning strategies in settings where the problem changes over time, the learner gets feedback through actions, or multiple agents are interacting.

subthemes.name: Learning with strategic or adversarial elements
subthemes.gist: Analyzing how learning algorithms perform when facing adversarial actors, noisy conditions, or game-theoretic interactions where agents have competing goals.

subthemes.name: Transferring knowledge across contexts
subthemes.gist: Understanding when knowledge learned in one setting can help in a different setting, and the conditions under which transfer learning succeeds or fails.

subthemes.name: Limiting privacy risks while learning
subthemes.gist: Building learning algorithms that extract insights from data while mathematically guaranteeing that sensitive information about individuals remains protected.

subthemes.name: Making predictions with few examples or limited data
subthemes.gist: Theoretical analysis of learning when data is scarce, including in-context learning, active selection of which data to gather, and efficient use of existing knowledge.

subthemes.name: How performance scales with model and data size
subthemes.gist: Understanding the mathematical relationship between performance and scale: how much better do models get as you make them bigger or give them more training data.
